transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this coordination huddle going. We've got Alpha and Bravo vehicle-operator recerts to schedule for next week. The training area has two four-hour blocks available: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. We need to nail down the schedule and list the evaluator for Alpha. Bravo's evaluator will be confirmed through battalion training after this huddle, so that's not part of our decision today. What do we know about evaluator availability and any conflicts I should be aware of?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the training database this morning — the only evaluator currently authorized for the Alpha cohort is Sgt. Lewis. He's available Monday 0800-1200. I haven't attached the evaluator roster to the weekly schedule yet, but the authorization is confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a conflict nobody's seen yet. I confirmed the bay booking today — Bravo's assigned vehicles are booked for preventive maintenance Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning. That means Bravo can only train Tuesday 1300-1700, after the motor pool releases them. The maintenance calendar hasn't been cross-referenced with the training schedule yet, so this hasn't been factored in.
